commands: v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/app/jwt_secret --with-decryption --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$v" ]; then echo 'ERROR: SSM parameter /op-deckbuilder/dev/app/jwt_secret is missing or empty. Create it: aws ssm put-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/app/jwt_secret --value "<long-random-secret>" --type SecureString --region us-west-2'; exit 1; fi; printf '%s\n' "JWT_SECRET=$v" >> /opt/app/.env
